questions.q: Solve 4 ÷ (x + 3) = x - 3. Give your answers to 3 significant figures. [3]
f(x) = 3x - 2 and g(x) = x² + 1. Find fg(2). [2]
Using f and g from question 3, find gf(x) in its simplest form. [2]
Prove that (2n + 1)² - (2n - 1)² is a multiple of 8 for any integer n. [3]
questions.a: 4n² + 4n + 1 - (4n² - 4n + 1) M1 = 8n A1; 8n = 8 × n, so a multiple of 8 A1
